critical_issues: Severe overexposure/highlight clipping across most of the frame; detail lost.
warnings: Reduce exposure aggressively: lower key/fill/rim light energies by ~5–10× and/or reduce scene exposure by ~1–2 stops so highlights don’t clip.
Increase contrast at the liquid-air interface: use a darker/neutral background and stronger side/back rim highlights so the oil surface and meniscus read clearly.
Make the oil visible: ensure the fluid mesh is actually being rendered and assigned the oil shader; add stronger volume absorption (or increase its density) to get a distinct amber tone.
Improve glass readability: add clearer rim highlights and ensure glass thickness/refraction is contributing (avoid lighting that washes out specular/refraction).
Render/collect more frames (ideally full 1–48) or at least a denser sampling so motion (continuous stream, surface ripples, level rise) can be assessed.

After changes, re-check a mid-frame histogram: you should see midtones and highlights not pegged at 1.0 (white) so oil/glass detail survives. سپس re-render and re-evaluate. (Ignore if non-English is undesired.)
